items.title: Global Payments (GPN) Cuts Annual Forecasts As Middle East Conflict Hits Travel Spending
items.summary: Global Payments cut its annual net revenue and profit forecasts after travel spending was disrupted by ongoing conflict in the Middle East. The payments company cited weaker volumes in travel related transactions as a key driver of the revised outlook. This move highlights how geopolitical events can affect cross border payment flows and consumer spending. For investors watching NYSE:GPN, the forecast cut comes with the stock trading at $88.25. items.title: Global Payments cuts annual forecasts as Middle East conflict hits travel spending
items.summary: Payment technology company Global Payments cut its annual net revenue and profit ‌forecasts on Wednesday amid economic uncertainty linked ‌to the war in the Middle East. Shares of the company, ​which are up 14% so far this year, fell about 2.7% in premarket trading following results. Here are some more details: • Payment processors such as Global ‌Payments are feeling ⁠the squeeze as the conflict in the Middle East disrupts global travel, reducing ⁠travel-related spending and cross-border transactions.
